correctness.rationale: For 0<epsilon<mu/N, all counts communicate. Detailed balance gives the exact adjacent stationary ratios. The sign polynomial has degree at most d+1 and is negative at both endpoints; each nonzero strict mode needs a separate positive component with two distinct real roots. This gives the proved ceiling. The displayed all-N construction has positive eps,beta,eta,delta and yields ratio pattern <1,>1,<1,>1,...,>1, with strict modes 0,2,N; N>=4 is necessary from nonadjacent peak positions. The exact 4-person witness has stationary masses proportional to 8192,4096,4608,4416,5727. Python exact-rational checks independently test labeled-state detailed balance and thousands of finite cases. Tests do not replace the universal algebraic proof.

value.rationale: The question is motivated by how the highest interaction order controls finite stochastic stationary epidemic regimes, not by an arbitrary small numerical example. The result gives a sharp interaction-order classification (at most 2 strict modes with pair/triad, at most 3 with tetrahedral), an all-N positive-rate realization of 3 modes, and the sharp minimal population size 4. It connects but is not equivalent to deterministic mean-field multistability and offers an exact finite benchmark. Large-rate and complete-mixing limitations are explicitly stated.
